mapper.sql: exists (select 1 from sys_user viewer where viewer.user_id = #{viewerId} and viewer.is_quanta_member = '1' and viewer.status = '0' and viewer.del_flag = '0' and (viewer.user_id = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role viewer_role on viewer_role.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = viewer.user_id and viewer_role.status = '0' and viewer_role.del_flag = '0' and viewer_role.role_key in ('ceo', 'qt_mgmt', 'qt_manager'))))
mapper.select: select p.post_id, p.title, p.category, p.visibility, p.content, p.author_id, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, ifnull(nullif(trim(u.real_name), ''), u.nick_name) as author_name, nullif(trim(mp.community_nickname), '') as author_community_nickname, u.member_department as author_department, u.avatar as author_avatar from qt_forum_post p left join sys_user u on p.author_id = u.user_id left join qt_member_profile mp on mp.user_id = u.user_id where p.post_id = #{postId}
select post_id, author_id, visibility from qt_forum_post where post_id = #{postId} for update

select p.post_id, p.title, p.category, p.visibility, p.content, p.author_id, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, ifnull(nullif(trim(u.real_name), ''), u.nick_name) as author_name, nullif(trim(mp.community_nickname), '') as author_community_nickname, u.member_department as author_department, u.avatar as author_avatar from qt_forum_post p
inner join qt_forum_post_like r on r.post_id = p.post_id inner join qt_forum_post_favorite r on r.post_id = p.post_id
left join sys_user u on p.author_id = u.user_id left join qt_member_profile mp on mp.user_id = u.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId}
and p.category = #{category} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into qt_forum_post (title, category, visibility, content, author_id, comment_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{category}, #{visibility}, #{content}, #{authorId}, 0, now(), now())
